condition: localized itchy blistery contact rash under nickel metal watch clasp
level_rationale: An itchy red patch of oozing blisters on the left wrist persisting today after wearing a new metal watch 4 days ago and taking it off yesterday indicates acute vesicular allergic contact dermatitis requiring an outpatient clinic visit for examination and prescription-potency topical corticosteroid therapy rather than unguided home care or emergency care, whereas a light clasp dent on the left wrist that smoothed out in 15 minutes after taking off the watch represents benign transient skin pressure indentation needing only routine self-care.
